text:
rita: Late-night latency surge recap. Error budget hit ~2.9% on prod-west. Root appears to be long sequences + JVM safepoint pauses on model workers. Need owners for fixes, dashboards, and SLO decision.

kevin: From traces: p95 jumped to ~320ms when seq>1100. p99 ~1.1s. Matches two prior incidents (2026-02-03, 2026-01-11).

sara: Quick mitigations: API cap at 1100 seq with informative header, short GC flag tweak on canary, add per-model p95 panel.

ops-bot: Alerts: latency-p95-prod fired 03:08 UTC (x4). Deployments: rollout-2026-03-25-a applied 03:15 UTC.

rita: Ownership proposal: kevin -> infra perf (canary GC tweak + soak), sara -> API guardrail + dashboard, rita -> SLO note and alert-window change.

kevin: I'll do GC tweak on canary tomorrow 06:00 UTC, 4h soak, then broader rollout if OK. ETA: perf report within 24h.

sara: I'll submit gateway middleware PR to enforce seq cap with 429-like response and link to docs. Canary in 30m. Also adding per-customer high-seq alert. ETA: EOD.

rita: SLO stance: keep p95 target; shorten alert window to 10m sustained >200ms for now. I'll draft SLO-update and post to #eng-sre. ETA: Thu EOD.

ops-eng: Can we add a 90d seq-distribution panel and a per-model p95 heatmap so we can spot recurrence faster?

sara: Yep, adding 90d seq histogram to incident dashboard.

kevin: If perf tweak doesn't fix it we'll explore batching heuristics / quantization. Note recurrence suggests workload shift. Add retro item to evaluate request-size quotas.

rita: Action list: infra perf - kevin - canary 06:00 UTC - status: assigned; API cap - sara - canary 30m - status: in progress; dashboards - sara - ETA EOD - status: assigned; SLO doc - rita - ETA Thu EOD - status: draft. Reconvene at SLO sync 10:00 UTC tomorrow.
